test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won the 2022 JCB Prize for Literature for his book ‘The Paradise of Food’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khalid Jawed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khalid Jawed's novel** "The Paradise of Food" earned him the **2022 JCB Prize for Literature. **
 
• Originally penned in** Urdu,** the book was translated** into English by Baran Farooqi. **
 
• Jawed, a professor at Jamia Millia Islamia University, is renowned as one of today's foremost Urdu novelists, with 15 works of fiction and non-fiction to his credit. 
 
• His accolades include the Katha Award, the Upendranath Ashk Award, and the UP Urdu Academy Award. 
 
• Published by Juggernaut Books in 2022, "The Paradise of Food" was selected from the JCB Prize's diverse shortlist by a panel of five judges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **A.S. Panneerselvan** holds the position of readers' editor at The Hindu, serves as adjunct faculty at the Asian College of Journalism, and is the executive director at Panos South Asia.
 
• **Amitabha Bagchi**, an Indian author, received the DSC Prize for South Asian Literature in 2019 and was shortlisted for both the JCB Prize for Literature and The Hindu Literary Prize for his novel "Half the Night is Gone."
 
• **Ramachandra "Ram" Guha,** an Indian historian, environmentalist, writer, and public intellectual, delves into various research areas encompassing social, political, contemporary, environmental, and cricket history, along with economics.
